events.text: You dream of a house you have never lived in, and in every room someone is waiting who knows your borrowed name. In the last room the owner of this body sits at the table, quite calm. "This was mine," they say. "I want it back."

choices.text: Stay at the table and do not look away

effects.log: You sit. They sit. Neither of you blinks until the candle burns down, and when you wake the hand on the blanket answers to you.

choices.text: Tell them you are sorry, and mean it

effects.log: They listen for a long time. "Sorry does not give it back," they say, but their voice is quieter, and the house grows dim around them.

choices.text: Tell them they are already gone

effects.log: You say it the way a judge says a sentence. The room goes cold, and they fade, and something in your own heart goes cold with them.

events.text: At breakfast your hand puts down the bowl and will not pick it up again. It is not your hand, it says without words, and it has been patient long enough. Across the table no one notices anything but a long pause.

choices.text: Lift the bowl, one finger at a time

effects.log: It takes the whole morning. By noon the hand is yours again, and the porridge is cold, and you eat it anyway.

choices.text: Let the hand rest, and talk to it inside

effects.log: You promise the will behind it that you will live well in its house. Slowly the fingers uncurl. It is not forgiveness. It is a truce.

choices.text: Force your will down the arm like a flood

effects.log: The hand jerks back to you so hard the bowl breaks on the floor. Somewhere inside, the other will cries out and goes very small.

events.text: In the market someone calls out a name that is not yours, the name this body was born with, and before you can stop it the body turns, smiling, ready to answer. The other will is very close to the surface now.

effects.log: You walk, and walk, until the name is far behind and the smile is yours to keep or drop. The other will sinks back down, tired.

choices.text: Let them see the friend, just for a moment

effects.log: For one breath you let the other look out through the eyes at the one who called. Then you take the eyes back, gently. They let you.

choices.text: Bury the name so deep it is never heard again

effects.log: You press the old name down until nothing in the body would turn for it, ever again. It works. You do not feel proud of it.

events.text: A mirror in an inn shows you a face that is still not quite used to you. As you watch, its expression changes on its own: not yours, older, angrier. "Every night I am a little stronger," it says. "And every night you are a little more tired."

choices.text: Hold its gaze until the face is yours

effects.log: It is a long night. In the end the face in the glass is only a face, wearing your tiredness and nothing else.

choices.text: Ask it what it would have done with its life

effects.log: It tells you: a garden, a small shop, a long quiet life. You promise to plant the garden. The face looks away, wet-eyed, and is yours.

choices.text: Turn the mirror to the wall, and the will with it

effects.log: You shut it out like a door on a storm. The silence after is complete, and heavy, and it follows you to bed.

events.text: In deep meditation you find a gate inside yourself you did not build, and behind it a will that has been gathering strength for years, waiting for you to be weak. Tonight you are not as strong as you would like to be.

choices.text: Stand in the gateway and hold it

effects.log: All night the other will pushes and you push back, two people leaning on one door. At dawn it gives way, and the gate closes, and you breathe.

choices.text: Open the gate and sit down with them

effects.log: You sit down on the threshold, unarmed, and wait. After a long time the other will sits down too, and lets you keep the house for one more night. Both of you rest.

choices.text: Break the gate and everything behind it

effects.log: You tear the gate down with all the strength of a soul that has survived death once already. Behind it there is nothing left to fight.
